title: Change your administration password
purpose: Replace the signed-in administrator’s own password.

sections.title: Access and fields
paragraphs: Requires an active staff account signed into administration. This is not the target-user password maintenance form.

items.label: Old password
items.description: Required existing password for the signed-in account.

items.label: New password
items.description: Required replacement with at least eight characters; account-similarity, common-password and numeric-only checks apply.

items.label: Change my password
items.description: Validates and saves, preserves this session’s authentication hash, and opens the password-changed acknowledgement. Other sessions using the old hash cease to authenticate.

items.label: Home
items.description: Returns to administration home without saving.

sections.title: Limits
paragraphs: No Forgot your password link appears on this stock form. No laboratory role, client assignment, release permission or factor record is changed. This self-service page does not invoke the project’s audited administrator change-of-another-user password handler. Password fields may need re-entering after errors.
